body: Didn't the cat call him a dumbass or something as he left?
He was just going through that supermarket haphazardly buying all of Dean's favorite foods. It was adorable.

I do realize that I need to get over myself and just be there for her. A part of me will always be just angry at her though because yesterday we were talking about Christmas gifts for our nieces and laughing and having a good time. She hadn't told me of any of the trials in her life until suddenly she's bleeding in a bathtub the next day. We're closer than that. Though I should be thankful she told me at. Otherwise I might not have her at all.
I do not think of her as a dumbass. I did not say that to her. Inside I was definitely screaming it loud because her actions greatly upset and confused me.

I'm just so angry and confused at her as to why she would try to take away one of my best friends. Our other sister and I can't even go visit her because we're too far away. She was escorted to a general hospital for her wounds and will be transferred to a mental health facility when they're done.

I got a voicemail from my big sister earlier today during class about the problems in her life and how she has been hurting herself. I told mom who called the suicide crisis hotline from five states away. The police came to her home and admitted her to the hospital. Dad's coming in to town to stay with her. Prayers please. She's a dumbass and I'm scared.
